policy: Retain every non-superseded physical module. Missing implementation or calibration is a status, not an exclusion. No selected unmodeled module may silently become a zero effect or an ideal efficiency.
scope: Working inventory from recovered v0.2-v0.9 papers, later council reviews and current conversation; add recovered modules without erasing history. Not a claim all historical attachments are recovered.

retained_modules.scope: water leaf, droplet/jet, replenishment, foil/film fabrication and specimen characterization
location, waveform, phase, frequency modulation, pretreatment duration and exposure history
pre-only versus sustain through arrival, drive-off delay and ringdown
sampled criteria, confirmation, timeout, target/batch readiness distributions and all-attempt logs
pulse shaping, contrast, preplasma, focus, timing and wall efficiency
independently characterized clean proton beam G0-B
optional RF/magnetic source preparation and finite density/transport constraints
planar/spherical, B/BN/B4C, isotope inventory, supports/mesh/apertures, orientation, porosity and damage
P0-P5 measured reactant polarization, host candidates, lifetime/survival, anisotropy and preparation cost
source-specific frames/observables, resonances, channels and uncertainty
physical masses/Q, sequential breakup, branch/angular distributions and Lorentz transforms
proton/alpha stopping, straggling, scattering, state changes and all exits
measured modes, stress/fatigue, heating, relaxation, flow residence time and target lifetime
laser-SBS/ion-acoustic effects where appropriate and separately defined IBW alpha-channeling hypotheses
magnetic/electric optics, electron populations, charge states, collisions and space charge
C1 electrostatic, C2 wave transfer, C3 hybrid, C4 inductive comparators and grid/material losses
finite retention, recovery/reinjection, losses and changing distributions
temperature/quality, recoverable boundaries, real offtake and conversion
conditioning, storage, internal reuse versus export, startup and complete cycles
single-pass reference, startup/drive-off, externally driven and grid-assisted burn
silicon telescope, CR39/TPS, diamond/SiC candidates, calibration, background, EMP and detector response
secondary reactions, neutron/gamma and activation diagnostics, decay, retention/recovery and market values
vacuum, cooling, magnets, controls, shielding, fuel/target processing, maintenance and downtime
optional site-dependent cryogenic/waste-stream integration
REFERENCE/OFF/SHAM/ON, grouped holdouts, all-shot metrics, factorial interactions and bounded optimization
installed CAPEX, OPEX, replacements, useful throughput, circular material handling and dated product markets

exclusion_rule: Only an explicit replacement/retirement/scope decision may exclude a module. Record source and reason. Mutually alternative technologies remain selectable branches; not all are physically simultaneous.

outside_Stars.reason: Explicit project-lead physics-only scope separation; retain in external research archive

superseded_assumptions: universal 675keV-CM identification of prominent pB source feature
generic independent acoustic/spin/wave yield multipliers as validated gains
BN stopping reused for unrelated materials
hardcoded alpha spectra represented as event-connected transport
